CANONICAL_NAME.value: emcee 3.1.6 -- the MCMC Hammer: affine-invariant ensemble sampler (Foreman-Mackey, Hogg, Lang, Goodman)

value.lineage: Markov chain Monte Carlo (Metropolis et al. 1953; Hastings 1970) via Goodman & Weare's affine-invariant ensemble 'stretch move' (2010), implemented for astronomy (2012) and used in thousands of papers. A compact, inspectable sampler: walkers, proposals, acceptance fractions, autocorrelation time.

value.built_to: draw samples from a posterior known only up to a constant, using an ensemble of walkers that adapts to the posterior's scale and orientation
value.pressure: high-dimensional, correlated, expensive likelihoods; hand-tuned proposal scales that fail when the posterior is anisotropic
value.success_means: sample moments match the target; autocorrelation time short relative to chain length

value.pressure: hidden parameters, expensive/black-box likelihood, anisotropic scales
value.failure_condition: the chain never mixes: acceptance ~0 or ~1, autocorrelation time longer than the run, moments wrong
